say:7:1434803006:1.text: You can't sleep when you're starving, you know?
say:7:1434803006:1.source_cn: 呵欠……梅林大人，您也知道……呵欠，一旦肚子饿，就会睡...

say:8:1434803007:1.text: But once you're full... *yawn* it hits you...

say:9:1434803008:1.text: This will be my first good nap in days... You wouldn't take that away from me, would you, Great Magister?
say:9:1434803008:1.source_cn: 这也是我这两天第一次……呵欠……睡个……好觉……您忍心...

say:11:1434803009:1.text: Hehe! Thank you, oh merciful Magister Merlin!

say:11:1434803009:1.male: Hehe! Thank you, oh merciful Magister Merlin!
say:11:1434803009:1.female: Hehe! Thank you, oh merciful Magister Merlin!

say:12:1434803010:1.text: You truly are the most beloved hamster friend in all the land!

say:13:1434803011:1.text: May your days be filled with tasty food, warm beds, and a life of joy, without any work!
